actions.description: Invite a user to the Calendly organization.
actions.name: create-user

email.description: Email address of the user to invite

actions.description: Create a webhook subscription in Calendly.
actions.name: create-webhook-subscription

events.description: The events to subscribe to. Example: ["invitee.created", "invitee.canceled"]

user.description: The user URI. Required when scope is "user". Example: "https://api.calendly.com/users/USER123"

signing_key.description: An optional secret key used to sign webhook payloads.

created_at.description: The moment the webhook subscription was created.

updated_at.description: The moment the webhook subscription was last updated.

retry_started_at.description: The moment retries started for a failing webhook subscription.

state.description: The state of the webhook subscription.

events.description: The events the webhook subscription is subscribed to.

scope.description: The scope of the webhook subscription.

actions.description: Delete or archive a webhook subscription in Calendly.
actions.name: delete-webhook-subscription

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the webhook subscription to delete. Example: "ABCD1234..."

actions.description: Retrieve a single event invitee from Calendly.
actions.name: get-event-invitee

event_uuid.description: The UUID of the scheduled event. Example: "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"

invitee_uuid.description: The UUID of the invitee. Example: "BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB"

actions.description: Retrieve a single event type from Calendly.
actions.name: get-event-type

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the event type. Example: "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"

actions.description: Retrieve a single scheduled event from Calendly
actions.name: get-scheduled-event

uuid.description: The unique identifier for the scheduled event. Example: "8pv58mskifkj5st9o6m2qqde74"

actions.description: Retrieve a single webhook subscription from Calendly.
actions.name: get-webhook-subscription

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the webhook subscription. Example: "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the webhook subscription.

callback_url.description: The callback URL to use when the event is triggered.

created_at.description: The moment when the webhook subscription was created.

updated_at.description: The moment when the webhook subscription was last updated.

retry_started_at.description: The date and time the webhook subscription retry started.

state.description: Indicates if the webhook subscription is active or disabled.

events.description: A list of events to which the webhook is subscribed.

scope.description: The scope of the webhook subscription.

organization.description: The organization associated with the webhook subscription.

user.description: The user associated with the webhook subscription.

creator.description: The user who created the webhook subscription.

group.description: The group associated with the webhook subscription.

event_uuid.description: The unique identifier for the scheduled event. Example: "GBGBDCAADAEDCRZ2"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

updated_at.description: When the invitee was last updated

old_invitee.description: Reference to the previous invitee if rescheduled

new_invitee.description: Reference to the new invitee if rescheduled

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results

actions.description: Remove a user from the Calendly organization.
actions.name: delete-user

actions.description: Retrieve a single organization membership from Calendly
actions.name: get-organization-membership

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the organization membership. Example: "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the organization membership

role.description: Role of the user within the organization (e.g., owner, admin, user)

organization.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the organization

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the user

scheduling_url.description: Calendly URL for the user's scheduling page

created_at.description: Timestamp when the user was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated

avatar_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image

user.description: Primary account details of the user

created_at.description: Timestamp when the organization membership was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the organization membership was last updated

actions.description: Retrieve a single routing form from Calendly.
actions.name: get-routing-form

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the routing form in UUID format. Example: "9f53ccd3-88e6-4c62-ad9e-91ea57d2187d"

active.description: Filter by active status. If true, returns only active event types. If false, returns only inactive event types.

count.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 100.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

organization.description: Organization URI to filter memberships. Example: "https://api.calendly.com/organizations/ABC123"

user.description: User URI to filter memberships. Example: "https://api.calendly.com/users/XYZ789"

email.description: Email address to filter memberships. Example: "user@example.com"

count.description: Number of results per page (max 100). Default varies by Calendly.

page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

role.description: Role of the user in the organization.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when user was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when user was last updated.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when membership was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when membership was last updated.

count.description: Number of items in the current page.

next_page_token.description: Token to fetch the next page of results.

organization.description: The URI of the organization to list routing forms for. If not provided, the action will fetch the current user's organization.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

count.description: Number of results per page. Default is 20.

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the routing form.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the routing form.

name.description: The routing form name (in human-readable format).

organization.description: The URI of the organization associated with the routing form.

status.description: The status of the routing form (e.g., active, disabled).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the routing form was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the routing form was last updated.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results.

actions.description: List scheduled events from Calendly. Returns a paginated list of events with optional filters for date range, status, and invitee email.
actions.name: list-scheduled-events

min_start_time.description: Minimum start time for events in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

max_start_time.description: Maximum start time for events in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"

invitee_email.description: Filter events by invitee email address

sort.description: Sort order for events. Default is "start_time:asc"

count.description: Number of events to return per page (max 100)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

scope.description: Scope of webhook subscriptions to return. Required when filtering by organization or user

sort.description: Sort order for results. Default: created_at:desc

count.description: Number of results per page. Max: 100, Default: 20

page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response

uri.description: Canonical reference for the webhook subscription

callback_url.description: URL where webhook events are sent

events.description: List of event types subscribed to

user.description: URL of the associated user, if scoped to user

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the subscription was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the subscription was last updated

creator.description: URL of the user who created the subscription

retry_started_at.description: When retry attempts started, if applicable

state.description: Current state of the webhook subscription

id.description: The URI of the invitee (used as unique identifier)
Unique identifier for the event type

uri.description: Canonical reference for the event type

active.description: Indicates if the event type is active

pooling_type.description: Pooling type for team event types

uri.description: Full URI of the webhook subscription

events.description: Array of event types subscribed to

user.description: URI of the user (when scope is user)

group.description: URI of the group (when scope is group)

updated_at.description: When the subscription was last updated

retry_started_at.description: When retries started for failed deliveries
